title: Define crypto2dev_provider.h API header
description:
Create include/crypto2dev_provider.h with the provider vtable and registration structs. No implementation, header only.

Must define:
- struct crypto2dev_algo_ops with callbacks: fips_gate, sess_init, sess_free, set_iv, set_aad, update, finalize, get_tag, set_tag
- struct crypto2dev_provider with name, algos array, num_algos, owner, list
- Function declarations: crypto2dev_register_provider(), crypto2dev_unregister_provider(), crypto2dev_lookup_algo()

This header is GPL-only (not UAPI). No wolfCrypt types anywhere.
